about.label: About Me
about.headline: Hey, I'm Vaibhav 👋
paragraphs: I'm a content strategist and video editor who works with Instagram and YouTube creators to help them grow, stay consistent, and actually look good doing it. I've helped creators go from zero to thousands of followers — and I bring that same energy to every project.

I'm a social media nerd — I'm online all the time, studying what works, what trends, and what catches the eye. That obsession is what powers the ideas and strategies I bring to every creator I work with.
about.quote: The real reason I do this? I have a genuine passion for social media. I create content myself, and that's exactly why I love helping others grow. This isn't just work for me — it's what I live and breathe.
